projects.name: Emerald Math · truthful enquiry flow
projects.why: The current intake marks submission successful in finally, including failure paths. A real visitor can see success without a successful request.
projects.goal: Only show success after an accepted enquiry. Keep typed input and offer a clear retry on failure.
steps: Write mocked cases for accepted, rejected and offline enquiry responses
Separate successful submission from cleanup; preserve input on failure
Verify retry and duplicate-submit behavior, then record the observed outcome

projects.name: AURA · dependable common commands
projects.why: The current fast path checks whether mute is inside the request, so unmute is treated as mute. Create-file requests also route to create_folder.
projects.goal: Selected everyday commands reach the intended tool with exact arguments and honest results.
steps: Add intent cases for mute, unmute, create file and create folder
Fix exact mute polarity and separate file creation from folder creation
Check malformed requests cause no action and record real outcomes separately from parser checks

projects.name: Kronos · close the setup evidence gap
projects.why: The repository handoff distinguishes Windows evidence from missing real Mac Keychain/setup checks. A repeatable small verification pass would make the build easier to trust.
projects.goal: A reproducible setup checklist and observed outcomes on the intended machine, without claiming mocked tests prove desktop behavior.
steps: Make a short fresh-install and credential-save checklist from HANDOFF.md
When the intended Mac is available, check Keychain save/read-back and launch manually
Check disposable-file operations and failure messages; record device and remaining gaps

projects.name: Kindle · prove the daily loop
projects.why: The source handoff still lacks observed cloud/device results, and filling data feels harder than deciding what to enter.
projects.goal: One usable afternoon on the phone with easy entry, source-linked work and a resume point that survives reopening.
steps: After the external build, add a task and personal project without instructions
Complete one real source-to-focus-to-resume-note journey and inspect Review
Check orb continuity, Reduce motion, large fonts and restart; note exact friction before changing more screens
